notation_review:
The entries below identify visible forms and the source's own statements about them. Cross-page crop comparisons are recorded in `notation_crosscheck.json`; the independent readings and their decisions remain in `second/`.

The recurring two-level prose shorthand is undergoing reconciliation against the blind readings. Its lower stroke varies from a shallow cup to a pronounced cup and cusp. No global substitution has yet been made. The round mark on Gamma is placed at the height shown locally: scan 061 line 12 has the lower position, while its nearby displays have raised circles. The two natural signs on scan 066 have matching offset bars and opposing stems. The two raised marks on the canceled J display of scan 077 are solid dots. Exact indices, decoration and location accompany these readings.

For witness wrappers excluded from the material counts, `accounting_review.json` and the per-page uncounted observations retain an occurrence key, the witness expression and the final expression. The correspondence is on those recorded text occurrences: for example, the same two-lobed handwritten E at the same coordinate is represented by H's `\mathcal E` and by the final `E`. The saved witness field recovers the original wrapper. This correspondence asserts no additional isomorphism between mathematical objects.
legibility:
The principal text is often readable through the high-resolution halves and local crops, but its compression varies markedly. Small terminal returns, detached accents, short abbreviation stops, nested indices and letters under cancellation carry most of the remaining uncertainty. The tightly retraced groups on scans 054 and 056, the overwritten base letters on 074–075, and the long canceled formulas on 077 deserve particular caution. Oblique marginal writing can overlap darker text from the body, as at the end of scan 054's note. A dark overlapping stroke can obscure a letter or a stop even after rotation.

Confidence belongs to the exact place recorded. Clear surrounding words do not settle a doubtful subscript, revision sequence or final letter. The transcription retains those doubts in place; the table records their competing readings and the particular stroke that remains unresolved. Doubt marks under cancellations have been kept where the complete canceled text cannot be read. No overall accuracy percentage is claimed.

C and H were each useful for locating disagreements. The consolidated reading preserves substantial source detail absent from H, including abbreviation forms, local punctuation, source revisions and marginal elements. C also required corrections at clear words, indices, omitted pieces and revision states, including places it had not marked doubtful. The counts in the changes log are counts of material decision places. They also include resolved C doubts, and a single place can affect both witnesses; they therefore do not give a measured error probability for either witness. Wrapper-only correspondences and changes of certainty alone are kept outside those material totals.
hand_review:
## Cross-page limits and comparisons

The local scope column is part of each observation. A compact terminal curl, for example, is checked with the neighboring word bodies and never supplies a universal rule for final s or punctuation. The broad Pi forms on scan 054 and the hooked small pi on scan 060 have been compared directly. Scan 061 preserves the two different heights of the round Gamma mark. The paired natural signs on 066 and the two solid raised J marks on 077 have also been compared on their saved crops.

For nested U indices, the arched form on 074 P02 and branched K on 075 P06 provide local comparisons. The shorter, intersected forms on 070 P09 and 073 P10 remain locally uncertain pending their blind audit decisions. The crop record gives the exact extent of these observations. Abbreviation expansions are collected in the doubts file's abbreviation list.
notes_appendix:
## Scope of the mathematical checks

The four check records are indexed by `N064_check_01`, `N072_check_01`, `N076_check_01`, and `N078_check_01`. Their proofs or computations appear under the corresponding pages. The first records the explicit fiber-product section maps and their two composites. The second computes a divisor and its restriction for the particular ring and open set stated there. The third records diagonal and evaluation for the explicit singleton index set. The fourth records the two maps between the displayed quotient rings and verifies their compositions.

The remaining conjectures, proposed implications, qualifications and requests for checking are reported as statements of the manuscript. Their presence in the transcription or notes alone has not been counted as a mathematical check. No external work was consulted to complete or correct the source's formulas.
sheet_feedback:
The page references in the table count each material decision place once under its primary category. Several places involve more than one feature, such as an inserted abbreviation whose attachment and stop both need reading; the assigned primary category prevents duplicate totals. Audit changes of certainty alone are recorded in their own tables and in the doubts list.

Two recurrent shapes deserve explicit examples in future versions of the sheet: the paired raised natural signs at 066 P13/P14, with offset bars and opposing stems, and the two solid raised marks on J at 077 P08. Their exact shapes recur within those cited places. The current broad symbol-and-index category covers the resulting corrections; the more specific forms are useful additions to its examples.

The other repeated difficulties encountered here have direct counterparts in the supplied sheet: long insertion leaders meeting formula indices; short final returns resembling extra letters or stops; the height and case of Pi; a zero-like round mark placed at different heights; overwritten S/T; cancellations retaining a live following comma; and words divided by a physical line break. Their individual decisions and scope are in the changes and hand logs. The comparison of prose shorthand remains open until its blind readings are reconciled.
